title: Iteration 36: EGO2048-S2 replication training on lane rep; three candidates in preparation
change: Admitted the frozen independent-seed replication of EGO2048 (lane rep, one H100). Helpers stage EGO-POOL2048 plus EGO2048 ladder bouts, a third replication seed, and an exploration variant EGO-EXPLORE2048.
result: Pod allocated; setup in progress. No new strength result yet.

steps.task: Iteration 36: EGO2048-S2 replication training on lane rep; three candidates in preparation

decision.reviewing: How to break the symmetric single-action self-play equilibrium without changing the objective
options: H2 EGO-POOL2048: frozen own-checkpoint partner pool for half of the self-play games (default-off flag, commit ddc76c53, 78+24+103+7 tests pass)
evidence: Self-play collapsed to one action by game 1920 with the policy target at the 25/32 search floor; replay then lacks states produced by foreign opponents
decision.reason: Implemented and validated last session; the remaining step is staging a hash-verified lane payload that also carries the EGO2048 ladder bouts so one pod yields both
decision.next_action: Helper emits payload, merged 26-job plan, validation and storage bounds; coordinator runs storage gate, preflight and launches lane pool

decision.reviewing: Which follow-up to append to the replication pod after the S2 chain
options: EGO2048-S3: a third audited training seed with the same frozen recipe and paired control, so seed stability rests on two independent replications
evidence: Promotion rules require independent training-seed replication; the lane rep pod and payload already carry the recipe, so the marginal cost is about 0.68 dollars plus bouts
decision.reason: Reuses the live pod and frozen inputs; no new code
decision.next_action: Helper validates the follow-up chain and seed audit; coordinator appends it after a fresh same-pod storage assessment

details.title: EGO2048-S3 third-seed replication package for the same lane rep pod
details.change: Helper audits a fresh training seed and fresh development-bout seeds, builds the follow-up chain (training, paired control, recovery, bouts, readout) appended after the S2 chain, validates with the supervisor and bounds storage/runtime.
details.result: Package in progress; appended to lane rep only after the S2 chain and a fresh same-pod storage assessment.

decision.reviewing: Is there a second independent lever against the self-play collapse besides the partner pool
options: EGO-EXPLORE2048: root exploration noise / temperature in self-play acting only, default-off flags, byte-identical reproduction when off
evidence: The root policy target sat at the 25/32 floor from game 1920 onward and hits per game stayed flat at 4.1; exploration in acting changes the replay distribution without touching reward, environment or evaluator
decision.reason: Independent of H2 and needs no owner approval, unlike reward shaping (H3)
decision.next_action: Helper implements, tests, pushes the branch and builds a paired development package with a preregistered gate
